message: carries `DATA-PCT-PART` — Angular sets a name there as written
$reason: The reference's error drawn as an SVG `<text>`, its part written `DATA-PCT-PART="error"`. Angular sets a name on such an element as written, and `setAttribute` keeps its case there, so in the browser Firefox and WebKit match no `[data-pct-part="error"]` on it, and Chromium does; its server renderer writes the name into the page as it stands, and the browser's HTML parser lowers it, so after hydration every engine matches it (measured on 2026-10-19: Chromium 153, Firefox 155, WebKit 26.6, the page from Angular 22.2's `renderApplication`). Read lowered, as the walk read every name, it passed; read as written, it would pass the page the server rendered. A name the gate reads, in capitals on an element of a foreign namespace, fails point 1. The walk lowered it and passed the part, and the styling API it names is one the page keeps in some engines and modes alone.
